title: Breathing difficulty
summary: Actual shortness of breath: onset, intensity, progression and context matter. A low SpO₂ is a finding, not a cause. A normal (for example 97 %), old or missing reading does not cancel severe or sudden shortness of breath. The oximeter estimates saturation and its reading can be affected by movement, poor placement or a weak signal. Informational support only: not a diagnosis or a treatment decision. No clinical personnel on board: the steps are first aid and monitoring; treatment depends on mission procedures.

immediate.text: Respiratory emergency: act now. A normal, old, simulated or missing SpO₂ does not cancel this alarm.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Call for emergency help now using the mission's means (ship alarm, crew, mission control if the link is up). Do not wait to see if it gets better.
If you have medication or oxygen prescribed for you in the medical kit, use it as prescribed.
Do not eat or drink while you are short of breath.
Keep the oximeter on and monitor pulse and SpO₂; a normal number does not mean you are getting better.
Another crew member: check airway, breathing and pulse; start CPR if needed, and keep monitoring breathing.

new_no_red_flags.text: Shortness of breath with no identified warning signs: follow these steps and monitor. If it becomes severe, starts suddenly or gets worse, treat it as an emergency.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Repeat the SpO₂ measurement at rest, following the oximeter instructions; do not rely on the number alone.
If you have medication prescribed for you (for example, an inhaler) in the medical kit, use it as prescribed.
Monitor your symptoms: if they get worse, are severe or the shortness of breath keeps you from sleeping, treat it as an emergency.

new_no_red_flags.mission_procedure: Mission medical procedure for shortness of breath

reading_check.text: Isolated reading with no known symptoms: confirm symptoms and repeat the measurement before interpreting it.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Repeat the measurement at rest, with the sensor placed correctly according to the oximeter instructions.
Pay attention to how you feel: the number alone neither confirms nor rules out anything.

reading_reference.text: The reading is within the visual reference. If symptoms appear, describe them here.

steps.text: Monitor your symptoms as well as the number.

questions.symptoms_and_repeat: Do you have shortness of breath or any other symptom right now? Repeat the measurement at rest, with the sensor placed correctly according to the oximeter instructions, and share the result.

candidates.minimum_evidence: Shortness of breath with reported cough or fever.
